intended_object: Given a family of global sections (s_i) that generates a sheaf of modules M, and an epimorphism p : M → N, the family (p(s_i)) of image sections generates N. Inferred from the docstring and the module's GeneratingSections structure (Stacks 01B4).
explanation:
This is faithful. In this file, `GeneratingSections` is a family `s : I → M.sections` such that the induced map `free I ⟶ M` is an epimorphism. `ofEpi` keeps the same index type and sends each section through `sectionsMap p`, i.e. it takes the image sections p(s_i). The file also shows that the induced map for the new family is the composite `σ.π ≫ p` (lemma `ofEpi_π`). A composite of two epimorphisms is an epimorphism, so the image sections generate N.

This matches the standard fact that the images of generators of M generate any quotient of M, with nothing missing or extra. It is stated for sheaves of modules over a sheaf of rings on a general site, which is the setting of the surrounding `GeneratingSections` structure, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no separate, more general version of this construction.
